name: gcc
description: The GNU Compiler Collection C compiler: compiles C (and with g++, C++) source into executables.

flags.description: Enable important warnings — use them always.
Compile only, producing an object file (.o).
Link the math library (order matters: after sources).

examples.explanation: Compiles hello.c into the executable hello with all common warnings enabled.
Multi-file build with debug symbols and standard optimization.
Produces module.o for later linking — how larger projects split compilation.
Runs the result. Executables need ./ because the current directory is not in PATH.

about: The typical pipeline: preprocess → compile → assemble → link. Warnings (-Wall -Wextra) catch most beginner bugs before runtime; -g enables gdb to map binaries to source lines. Debug and release builds differ: -O0 -g for debugging, -O2 for production.
mistakes: Forgetting -lm when using math functions: "undefined reference to sqrt".
Running the output without ./ — the shell does not search the current directory.
distroNotes: gcc is the default C compiler on virtually all distributions (package: gcc / build-essential on Debian, gcc / Development Tools group on RHEL).
